page.notes: The Greek is set in small type and only partly legible at this scan. Its exact letters are uncertain and are marked [?] where doubtful, especially the opening Greek words of the first line and the Greek after "Suidas in voce". The Latin is read with confidence except where a word is italic, but the italic commentary lines are in the column, not in a margin, so they are kept as <i>. The stray mark below the text and the ornamental border are not printed text. The edge of the facing page at the left is excluded.
